Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:10:1.english: He surely stated before him - [He] has already informed him what he stipulated for us, and he consented.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:11:1.english: Did Rabbi Yochanan say this - That [mere] words involve a lack of trustworthiness.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:11:2.hebrew: יכול לחזור בו - וקשיא לן: יכול, פשיטא! דהא לא משך, ואין כח בב"ד לכופו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:11:2.english: He is able to retract - And it is difficult for us: [Why state] "he is able" — [that is] obvious! For he has not performed an act of pulling [to acquire it], and the court has no power to compel him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:11:3.hebrew: אלא - ודאי על כרחך מותר לחזור בו קאמר, ואשמעינן דאפילו חסרון אמנה ליכא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:11:3.english: Rather - Certainly, he is necessarily saying "it is permitted to renege on it," and he teaches us that there is not even a lack of trustworthiness.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:11:4.hebrew: מודה ר' יוחנן במתנה מועטת - שאין מותר לחזור, משום דסמכא דעתיה דמקבל אדיבוריה. וכי אמר "מותר לחזור בו", במתנה מרובה קאמר, דלא סמכא דעתיה דמקבל דלקיימיה לדיבוריה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:11:4.english: Rabbi Yoḥanan concedes in [the case of] a small gift - That it is not permitted to renege, because the recipient relies on his word. And when he said "it is permitted to renege," he was speaking of a large gift, where the recipient does not rely [on him] to fulfill his word.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:12:1.english: To a son of Levi - Every Levite is called a son of Levi.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:12:2.english: You have a kor of tithe in my possession - That I separated as tithe from my produce and will give it to you.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:12:3.hebrew: תרומת מעשר - שהלוי מפריש מעשר לכהן, מעשר מן המעשר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:12:3.english: Teruma of the tithe - Which the Levite separates [as] a tithe for the priest — a tithe from the tithe.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:12:4.hebrew: משום הכי רשאי - שיש לו לסמוך על מה שכתוב (צפניה ג׳:י״ג): "שארית ישראל לא יעשו עולה ולא ידברו כזב", ולא יתננו ללוי אחר. והא מתנה מועטת היא, שאין לישראל במעשר זה אלא טובת הנאה, שהיה בידו מתחילה לתת לכל בן לוי שירצה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:12:4.english: Due to that, he may - For he may rely on that which is written (Zephaniah 3:13): "The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity, nor speak lies," and [the Israelite] will not give it to another Levite; and this is a small gift, for the Israelite has nothing in this tithe except the benefit of discretion, which was in his hand from the outset to give [it] to whichever Levite he wishes.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:14:1.english: He has no [claim] against him - The first Levite has no [claim] against this Israelite.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:14:2.english: Only a grievance - For he promised him with a disappointed hope.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:14:3.hebrew: אלא ש"מ בדלא נטלו - ויש בדברים משום חסרון אמנה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:14:3.english: Rather, conclude from it that he did not take it - and [thus] verbal [commitments] involve a lack of trustworthiness.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:15:1.hebrew: אפילו שומר חנם נמי לא הוי - ואפילו פשעו בשמירתן, פטורין:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:15:1.english: He is not even an unpaid bailee - And even if they were negligent in guarding them, [they are] exempt.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:15:2.hebrew: והא בעי לקבולי כו' - ודלמא לא הוי מקבל, ואישתכח דזוזי דידיה הוה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:15:2.english: But isn't he required to accept, etc. - And perhaps he would not have accepted [the curse], and it would turn out that the money was his [i.e., the seller's].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:15:3.english: Indeed - Either he pays [the value of] the sesame, or he accepts [the curse of] "He Who exacted payment."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:16:1.hebrew: בדידי הוה עובדא - אותו מעשה דשומשמין על ידי היה, ולא כן היה. שאילו קיבלתים לתת את השומשמין, לא הייתי חוזר בי בכל חללו של עולם, ולא על כן באנו לדין, אלא כך היה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:16:1.english: There was an incident in which I [was involved] - That incident of the sesame occurred with me, and it was not like that [which was reported]. For had I accepted them [the dinars] to give the sesame, I would not have retracted for the entire expanse of the world, nor did we come to judgment over that; rather, it was as follows:

Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:1:1.hebrew: אלא משכון דתפס - למאי תפס, אם לא להיות משכון תחת שוויו? ובההיא מיהא לא קרינא ביה "לא יגוש":
Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:1:1.english: Rather, the collateral that he seized - Why did he seize [it], if not for the collateral to be in place of its value? And regarding that [portion] at least, we do not apply to him "he shall not exact [payment]."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:1:2.hebrew: אינו משמט בכולו - כלומר, אינו משמט כלל:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:1:2.english: [It] does not abrogate the entire [loan] - That is to say, it does not abrogate [it] at all.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:3:1.hebrew: מכלל דר' יהודה כו' - קושיא הוא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:3:1.english: By inference that Rabbi Yehuda, etc. - It is a question.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:4:1.hebrew: במאי דנקיטת זוזי הב להו - ואי לא, מקבלת מי שפרע:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:4:1.english: For what you received money, give them - And if not, you receive [the curse of] "He Who exacted punishment" [*mi shepara*].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:4:3.hebrew: דברים נינהו - בלא מעות. רב לטעמיה, דאמר כנגדו הוא קונה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:4:3.english: They are [mere] words - Without money. Rav [follows] his own reasoning, as he said: "He acquires [only] corresponding to it."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:6:1.hebrew: הין בכלל איפה - שההין י"ב לוגין, ואיפה שלשה סאין שהן ע"ב לוגין:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:6:1.english: A hin [was] included in an ephah - For a hin [is] twelve logs, and an ephah [is] three se'ahs, which are seventy-two logs.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:6:2.hebrew: אלא שיהא הן שלך כו' - כלומר, כשאתה מדבר הן או לאו, קיים דבריך והצדק אותם:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:6:2.english: Rather, that your "yes" should be, etc. - That is to say, when you say "yes" or "no," fulfill your words and make them true.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:6:3.hebrew: שלא ידבר אחד בפה כו' - בשעה שהוא אומר הדבור, לא יהא בדעתו לשנות. אבל אם נשתנה השער לאחר זמן והוא חוזר בו לפי שינוי השער, אין כאן חסרון אמנה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:6:3.english: That one should not say one [matter] with [his] mouth, etc. - At the time that he utters the statement, it should not be in his mind to change [his commitment]; however, if the market price changed after some time and he retracts because of the change in the market price, there is no lack of trustworthiness here.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:7:1.hebrew: אבל אמרו חכמים כו' - סיפא קתני: החוזר בו, אין רוח חכמים נוחה הימנו. אלמא, יש בהן משום מחוסרי אמנה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:7:1.english: But the Sages said, etc. - The latter clause [of the Mishnah] teaches: One who retracts, the spirit of the Sages is not pleased with him. Thus, [such cases] involve [the status of] those who lack trustworthiness.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:8:1.english: It is [a dispute between] tannaim - For we find Rabbi Yochanan ben Matya who disagrees.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:8:2.hebrew: מעשה בר' יוחנן כו' - משנה היא בהשוכר את הפועלים, שצוה את בנו לחזור בתנאו עד שלא יתחילו המלאכה, ולפסוק להם מזונות קלים:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:8:2.english: An incident involving Rabbi Yochanan, etc. - It is a Mishnah in [the chapter] HaSokher et HaPoalim, where he commanded his son to retract his stipulation before they begin the work, and to allocate simple sustenance for them.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 49a:9:1.english: They do not rely - on the words of the son.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 49a:11:1.english: Rabbi Yochanan concedes in [the case of] a small gift - And [a] price increase is also like a small gift.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 49a:13:1.hebrew: וחזר והפקידו אצלו - ה"מ למפרך: "אי הכי, מאי למימרא?" אלא דבלאו הכי פריך שפיר מסיפא:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 49a:13:1.english: "And he then deposited it with him" - [The Gemara] could have objected: "If so, what [need is there] to state [this]?" However, even without that, it objects effectively from the latter clause.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 49a:15:1.hebrew: אלא אפי' שומר חנם נמי לא הוי - והא דאמר בפרק האומנין (לקמן בבא מציעא דף פ:): "טול שלך והבא מעות — שומר חנם", היינו משום דמעיקרא היה שומר שכר, וכשא"ל "טול שלך", לא לסלק עצמו לגמרי משמירה קאמר, אלא שלא יהיה שומר שכר:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 49a:15:1.english: "But [he] is not even an unpaid bailee" - And [as for] that which [it] says in chapter HaOmanin (later, Bava Metzia 80b): "Take yours and bring money — [he is] an unpaid bailee," that is because initially he was a paid bailee, and when he said to him, "Take yours," he did not mean to completely remove himself from safeguarding, rather [only] that he should not be a paid bailee.
